title: ロボット設計演習Ⅰ
subtitle: Engineering Exercise for Robotics I
educationalGoal: (1) Learn mechanical design skills by designing a microcomputer car in a team environment. (2) Practice mechanical drawing skills while designing the microcomputer car. (3) Apply knowledge of mechanical design and machining to an actual robotic system.
advice: This is a practical course in designing a robotic microcomputer car. We will cover the following topics: 1. Design of a steerage mechanism 2. Design of the structural frame 3. Machining and assembly of parts Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to work together on a team to complete tasks in class. Students are expected to machine some car parts after school hours.
books: Textbooks:New JIS mechanical drawing(5th edition),Moritika Publishing(in Japanese) Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Completion of Engineering Mechanics I and II, Mechanics of Materials, and Mechanical Drawing I and II. Sufficient skill in plate machining, drill press machining, milling machining, and (lathe) turning. Students are required to not only have enough skills but also acquire a YUMEKOBO license (Sheet metal working, Drilling Machine, Lathes, and Milling Machine).

activityGoals.body: Understand and explain the major points of the design.
Understand the design process and how to design a microcomputer car.
Make detailed technical drawings compliant with JIS requirements with a computer-aided design system.
Create an assembly drawing and part drawings based on the machining that will be used for manufacturing.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
